title: 2 Hour Mangrove Maze Kayak Tour in Key West
includes: Explore Mangrove Creeks and Tunnels and Salt Ponds
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Weight Limit is 250lbs Single or 580lbs Double Kayak.
policies: Please arrive promptly 15 minutes before your tours's start time to check in.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Navigate through the stunning Mangrove Tunnels on this engaging 2-hour kayak tour in Key West. Ideal for all ages and skill levels, this adventure allows you to explore diverse ecosystems while searching for fascinating wildlife like manatees, nurse sharks, and playful dolphins. Led by knowledgeable guides, every excursion provides a unique experience filled with insights about the local flora and fauna. With single and double kayaks available, gather your family or friends for an unforgettable journey through the mangroves.

- Tour duration: 2 hours, suitable for ages 6 and up
- Max group size of 35, ensuring a personalized experience
- Spot wildlife including manatees, sea stars, and birds
- Essential gear: sunscreen, water, and waterproof items recommended
